meta.title: RepoChan Asset City · Isometric Toy-City Pipeline
meta.description: Welcome to Asset City: the whole RepoChan pipeline rebuilt as a clickable isometric miniature city — from the Analysis Tower to the Deploy Dock. Pick a building, meet a stage.

hero.title: Welcome to Asset City.
hero.lead: The entire RepoChan pipeline lives here as a miniature city: Analysis Tower, Interview Café, Persona Studio, Foundation Hall, Painter Shed, Sticker Shop, and the Deploy Dock at the far pier. RepoChan herself patrols the central plaza — click any building to see what happens inside.
hero.hint: Click buildings to explore · dashed roads show dependencies · start at the tower

gate.name: City Gate Station
gate.tagline: Every tour starts at the station: install the CLI and let it set up the skill packs for your agent.
gate.input: A git repo + your favorite agent
gate.output: A global repochan command with skills installed

tower.name: Analysis Tower
tower.tagline: The radar on the roof sweeps your repo end to end: stack, structure, doc tone — all pinned into a deterministic report.

cafe.name: Interview Café
cafe.tagline: Sit down, grab a drink, answer a few questions: tone, audience, weight, world. What the scanner can't read, conversation can.

studio.name: Persona Studio
studio.tagline: A world architect, a character designer, and a consistency guardian work in shifts to knead the reports into a living mascot.

hall.name: Foundation Hall
hall.tagline: The most important library in town: the foundation sheet is settled here first, and every later commission comes back to check its answers.

shed.name: Painter Shed
shed.tagline: Orders on the wall, references pinned, matte backgrounds laid — the painter ships in dependency order, and repaints are unlimited.

shop.name: Sticker Shop · Poster Pole
shop.tagline: The window is always stocked: a nine-grid of reaction stickers, the freshest poster on the pole — every piece from a real order.
shop.input: Master sheets from the Painter Shed
shop.output: Cut grid tiles, derivatives, poster versions

dock.name: Deploy Dock
dock.tagline: Assets crated, pages assembled, localization checked — once the ship leaves, your project owns a city of its own.

souvenir.title: Sticker Shop Window
souvenir.lead: All nine sticker tiles on duty — sliced from a single 2K master sheet, now at your service.

footer.line: Asset City was built by the actual RepoChan pipeline
footer.credits: Character: RepoChan (Sugar Riff) · Buildings: SVG blocks · Assets: real order outputs
